name: B2-2 RSS AI News Summary Automation

nodes.purpose: Run the same runtime path as the schedule trigger for manual testing.
Run every day using NEWS_CRON_EXPRESSION and NEWS_TIMEZONE.
Run the production path through POST /webhook/{NEWS_WEBHOOK_PATH} for operational and failure testing.
Read environment variables and validate required runtime settings.
Load enabled RSS sources from NOTION_RSS_CONFIG_DB_ID.
When no enabled RSS source exists, log NO_RSS_SOURCES and end successfully without reseeding.
Load enabled topic keywords from NOTION_TOPIC_CONFIG_DB_ID.
When no enabled keyword exists, log TOPIC_CONFIG_EMPTY and end successfully.
Turn Notion RSS Sources DB rows into feedUrl items for RSS Feed Read.
Process enabled RSS sources one by one.
Fetch RSS items for the current source with a bounded timeout and retry policy.
Normalize title, originalUrl, guid, dedupeKey, publishedAt, RSS fallback content, and source.
Fetch the original article HTML from originalUrl after reading the RSS item.
Strip HTML from the article page, store articleText, and use it as the primary content for filtering and summarization.
Keep items whose title, articleText, or fallback content matches enabled topic keywords.
When there is no matching item, log NO_TOPIC_MATCH and end successfully.
Select the newest one matching candidate.
Check NOTION_NEWS_DB_ID by Dedupe Key or Original URL before calling Ollama.
When candidate already exists, log DUPLICATE_SKIPPED and do not call Ollama.
Call OLLAMA_BASE_URL/api/generate once for the selected non-duplicate article.
Reject empty, invalid JSON, or longer-than-three-line summaries.
Save title, summary, original URL, published date, dedupe key, source, keywords, model, and saved time.
Write SAVED_TO_NOTION to the n8n execution log.
Build a Discord success notification with title, URL, published time, and model.
Send the success notification to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL without failing the saved result if Discord is unavailable.
Send RSS, Ollama, Notion, and workflow errors to Discord. Log Discord failures only.
